messages.author: 18c624431dbfdf9f
messages.subject: error with theme_bwplot and facets
parts:
I've been playing around with the lovely ggplot2, but have encountered
an odd problem. When I add theme_bw to my lastplot, the y axis legend
appears to slip down the side of the graphs to the bottom. For long
text, this even cuts off some of the axis text. See the following odd
example.

x<-1:100
g<-as.factor(c("A", "B", "C", "D"))

z<-data.frame(expand.grid(x=x,g=g))

z$y<- rnorm(length(z$x),z$x*c(3,15,29, 50)[unclass(z$g)]+5, sd=200)

a<-qplot(x,y,group=g, colour=g, data=z, facets=~g)
a+stat_smooth(method="lm", se=T, group=g, fill="black")
last_plot()+theme_bw()



Note how the y moves to the bottom of the graphic. What's going on
here?

N.B. I'm using version 0.8.2 on a powerbook mac running osx.

-Jarrett
